reading.label: earMUSIC
reading.notes: Vinyl label for Side B with a large red/white 'F' logo. There is no proper tracklist with positions. The background shows faded, partly obscured decorative text with song-title fragments: 'DOUBLE VISI…', 'HEAD GAMES', 'COLD…', 'WAITI… …RE YOU', '…LOVE', '…NING BLUE DAY…'. These are partly covered by the logo and are not a sequenced tracklist. The rim text is partly legible: '℗© 2025 Trigger Productions, Inc. under exclusive license to earMUSIC, a label of edel Germany GmbH. All rights reserved', 'Made in Germany by Optimal Media GmbH', 'GEMA/BIEM'. A code on the rim, possibly '0215238EMU', is uncertain. The centre spindle area shows 'Techn…', which is from a turntable mat or sticker and not part of the label.
